question: Which Indian diplomat was conferred the First Class Order of Zayed II award by UAE in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Navdeep Singh Suri.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Navdeep Singh Suri,** India’s envoy to the United Arab Emirates, has been honoured with the **First Class Order of Zayed II award in 2019.**
 
• He was awarded by UAE President Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan for his contribution to the development and strengthening of friendly relations and cooperation between India and UAE during his tenure.
 
• **About United Arab Emirates:**
 
 
• **​Capital:** Abu Dhabi
 
• **President: **Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
 
• **Currency: **United Arab Emirates dirham
 
• **Prime minister:** Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In June 2020, **Raveesh Kumar** has been appointed as India's next Ambassador to Finland.
